caveats: suite standard-v1 frozen: frozen workload definition; prompts are synthetic token-id sets derived deterministically from prompt ids, so no private user prompts are collected; standard measurement shape: 512 input / 256 output tokens with exact recorded prompt ids and cache conditions; cache labels are explicit: cold-declared, warm, prefix-hit, or cache-uncontrolled; a first run is not automatically a cold-storage run; reference inputs are compared only through the four-way identity in PRD section 20.1 (R0/R1/T0/T1); draft tokens are never reported as final throughput

all throughput figures count model tokens from the worker's Done frame: throughput_median_tps is end-to-end (generated tokens / total request time, including TTFT) and throughput_decode_median_tps is (generated - 1) over the worker's first-to-last sampled-token span; ttft_ms, visible_chunks, and the gap percentiles describe the visible stream (user experience), not token production
experimental backend tuckcore: uncertified kernels; real weights executed, performance and quality unmeasured
logical read traffic is measured weight bytes read via positioned reads; not physical SSD counters
footprint sampled from proc_pid_rusage at ~50ms cadence
cold-start and warm-cache are separate labels; this run's cache state is declared explicitly
cache state was not controlled or established; treated as uncontrolled
batch-local classification requires explicit slow-mode acceptance
